<!-- Included via revealjs `include-after-body` from lectures/*.qmd (depth 1: ../js, ../index.html). -->
<a class="lecture-home-link" href="../index.html">← Course Home</a>
<script src="../js/embed-bridge.js"></script>
<script src="../js/text-to-speech.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var tries = 0;
  var iv = setInterval(function () {
    tries++;
    if (window.Reveal && typeof window.Reveal.isReady === "function" && window.Reveal.isReady()) {
      clearInterval(iv);
      EmbedBridge.parentInit();
      initReadAloud();
    } else if (tries > 100) {
      clearInterval(iv);
    }
  }, 100);

  function getSlideText(section) {
    if (!section) return "";
    var clone = section.cloneNode(true);
    var strip = clone.querySelectorAll("button, iframe, .activity-embed-controls, aside.notes, .read-aloud-btn");
    for (var i = 0; i < strip.length; i++) strip[i].remove();
    return clone.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  function initReadAloud() {
    if (!window.TextToSpeech) return;
    var btn = TextToSpeech.createReadAloudButton(
      function () { return getSlideText(Reveal.getCurrentSlide()); },
      { label: "🔊 Read this slide", className: "lecture-read-aloud-btn" }
    );
    if (!btn) return; // no speech synthesis support in this browser
    document.body.appendChild(btn);
    // Don't keep reading a slide the presenter has already navigated away from.
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", function () { TextToSpeech.stop(); });
  }
})();
</script>
